provenance.note: get_strike_profile's misses and its silences, worked by hand from the M37 rules (contracts::strike, analysis::strike's builders) and ADR-024's M35 addendum before golf-mcp answered them. Read under this build's engine pair {installed 17, comparable_from 14}. Golfers aaron (Aaron, with a bag declaring a 7i) and ben (Ben, nothing on file). Nobody slugs to nobody, who is not registered, and !!! slugs to nothing, so no golfer: both answer the miss, with career::missing_golfer_profile's sentence and the name as typed, quoted as Python's repr quotes it. ben has no swing: the profile is empty, not refused, with n_shots 0, no club, no topic, no blend key, an empty dispersion and an empty list. AARON folds to aaron. Aaron's corpus: 2026-09-10/1, a photo entry (photo-10-1, carry 150, HD Golf, no club) that is admitted; 2026-09-10/2, a photo entry practised as a drill (photo-10-2, carry 140), untracked and in no count; 2026-09-11/1, a clip tagged 7i (engine 17, head_sway_norm 0.3) with no shot photo. So n_shots is 1 and untagged_shots 1 (the drill's photo is not a shot of the corpus). No club is graded: the 7i is declared and hit only on a clip with no photo, so its n_shots is 0 and it is no club of the profile. No topic exists for the player: consistency and low point need a club, and the untagged owner has none, while the 7i owner has no shot to see either; strike location needs an impact offset HD Golf does not print; and no shot was declared a shape. No topic is graded, so there is no blend key. The player's strike carries no ball speed (club-only) and no impact map (no strike location), and its dispersion is empty, since neither club-independent metric (start_line_deg, face_to_path_deg) is held by any entry. The list is empty: carry and head sway have one sample each, which establishes nothing. The view is golf-core profile --json's element, display_name then the GradedProfile.
